name: 14-day-threshold-quiet-by-default
description:
Scenario 13's scene exactly - a dim room whose day pipeline never gets under total_gain_day_threshold, so the probe reverts and the warn's condition is TRUE - with the opt-in key absent. The only assertion is the forbid_log: a camera that has not asked for threshold diagnostics must not be told about them.

This pins the gate, not the message. The warn reports a genuine misconfiguration and is worth having on demand, but its condition persists until a human edits the config, so unconditionally it is one WARN per reconfirm interval, forever, on flash-backed syslog - on a correctly-configured fleet that is pure log growth, and on a misconfigured camera one line an hour all night makes the point many times over. Same reasoning as daynight.trace_path. If the gate is ever removed or inverted, 13 keeps passing and only this scenario notices.

Duration is cut to one probe/revert cycle because that is all it takes for the condition to arise - 13 carries the content assertions.

forbid_log: day can never be confirmed here
